One person stands about an arm’s length away, facing the camera wearer and the upright wooden structure. The wood pile is directly between them and within the wearer’s reach. The person appears ready to receive another piece, with neither person obstructing the other’s path. The most appropriate action is to pass the needed wood element so they can continue assembling the sculpture; this efficiently supports the ongoing task.
